en.headline: Multiple collisions on North Lantau Highway disrupt airport traffic
en.dek: Ten accidents involving 29 vehicles left five people injured this morning near Siu Ho Wan, with temporary lane closures towards the airport.
body: Police received reports of ten traffic accidents on the North Lantau Highway towards the airport between about 7:25 a.m. and 9:06 a.m. on Saturday, involving a total of 29 vehicles. Three of the incidents left five people with minor injuries.

One of the larger collisions, reported around 7:27 a.m. near the Siu Ho Wan depot and Shun Long Road, involved eight vehicles including private cars, taxis and a light goods vehicle. The Transport Department said part of the carriageway towards the airport was closed for a time, leaving only the remaining lanes open and causing congestion.

The department advised travellers heading to the airport to consider the MTR and to allow extra time. By about 9:30 a.m. the closed lanes had been reopened, though residual queues were still clearing. Vehicle damage in the reported incidents was described as not serious.

zh.headline: 北大嶼山公路多宗車禍 往機場方向一度封閉部分行車線
zh.dek: 今早約兩小時內發生十宗交通意外，涉29輛車，其中三宗造成五人輕傷，運輸署曾封閉近小蠔灣部分行車線並呼籲市民乘搭港鐵。
body: 警方接獲報告，今早約7時25分至9時06分，北大嶼山公路往機場方向先後發生十宗交通意外，共涉及29輛車，當中三宗意外造成五人輕傷。
其中一宗較大型的碰撞約於7時27分在近小蠔灣車廠及順朗路一帶發生，涉及八輛車，包括私家車、的士及輕型貨車。運輸署表示，往機場方向近小蠔灣車廠的部分行車線一度封閉，駕駛人士只可使用其餘行車線，現場交通繁忙。
運輸署呼籲前往機場的市民考慮使用港鐵服務，並預留充裕時間。至上午約9時半，封閉的行車線已解封，車龍仍在消散。報道指各宗意外的車身損毀不算嚴重。
